segments.t: In Mathias's office at ASK, Noemie reveals a wonderful personal surprise. Free at last from her medical neck brace, she shows off her restored mobility and shares a playful, affectionate exchange with Mathias. Listen to the scene in French first.

Non, qu'est-ce qui a changé?
Vous ne voyez vraiment rien là?
Je ne vois rien de particulier.
Je n'ai plus mon corset!
Ça y est, c'est enfin fini!
C'est une excellente nouvelle, Noémie.
Regardez, je peux bouger librement maintenant.
Je peux même danser pour vous!

Let's walk through the conversation step by step.
Vous n'avez rien remarqué d'important?
'Did you not notice anything important?' Noemie teases Mathias about his lack of observation. The negative question draws attention to her appearance.
Non, qu'est-ce qui a changé?
'No, what has changed?' Mathias wonders what he managed to miss. The confused response seeks clarification.
Vous ne voyez vraiment rien là?
'Do you truly see nothing there?' She points to her neck and posture. The playful question prompts a closer look.
Je ne vois rien de particulier.
'I see nothing in particular.' Mathias looks around without spotting the change. The honest admission confesses his blindness.
Je n'ai plus mon corset!
'I do not have my neck brace anymore!' Noemie joyfully reveals she has taken off her medical brace. The cheerful announcement marks recovery.
Ça y est, c'est enfin fini!
'That is it, it is finally over!' She celebrates the end of her convalescence. The relieved exclamation expresses pure joy.
C'est une excellente nouvelle, Noémie.
'That is excellent news, Noemie.' Mathias smiles with relief at her physical recovery. The warm adjective congratulates his assistant.
Regardez, je peux bouger librement maintenant.
'Look, I can move freely now.' She demonstrates her restored mobility. The imperative verb invites him to observe her movement.
Je peux même danser pour vous!
'I can even dance for you!' Noemie playfully offers a joyful demonstration. The modal verb highlights her newfound freedom.
Moi, j'aimais bien votre corset.
'As for me, I actually liked your brace.' Mathias admits his fondness for her former look. The personal confession reveals tender affection.
Ah bon, vous trouviez cela bien?
'Oh really, did you think that was nice?' She reacts with playful surprise to his compliment. The teasing question continues their banter.
Oui, cela vous allait très bien.
'Yes, it suited you very well.' Mathias confirms his genuine appreciation. The affirmative statement compliments her charm.
Je pourrais le remettre pour vous.
'I could put it back on for you.' Noemie flirts with a humorous promise. The conditional verb offers a playful compromise.
Si cela peut vous faire plaisir!

'If that can bring you pleasure!' She finishes her tease with a bright smile. The lighthearted remark deepens their romantic connection. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

A moment of lighthearted relief brings Noemie and Mathias closer together amidst hectic agency life. Listen to the conversation once more in French.
Vous êtes toujours pleine de surprises.
